title: The Star-Astrolabe of Elinhir
summary: Unmask a Scaled Court serpent-cult conspiracy that is rigging gladiatorial bouts in Dragonstar Arena and stealing Nede star-lenses from Elinhir to awaken the Sanctum Ophidia.

npcs.name: Astromancer Nadia of Elinhir
npcs.greet: Look to the apex of the wizard-towers, traveller! Someone shattered the Nede bronze astrolabe of Elinhir and carried off the Serpent-Lens.
talk: For centuries Elinhir's mage-patrons have kept the Nede star-lenses sealed to prevent the Scaled Court from aligning the vaults of Sanctum Ophidia.
The thief wore the bronze baldric of a Dragonstar Arena promoter. Travel to Belkarth and speak with Caravan-Master Jibril.

npcs.name: Caravan-Master Jibril
npcs.greet: Between the Colovian border-guards, the Nord squatters in West Dragonstar, and the snake-cultists in the hills, a caravan needs six swords per mule!
talk: Promoter Volus at Dragonstar Arena has been drugging champion fighters with serpent-venom and sending their bodies south toward Sanctum Ophidia.
Go to Dragonstar and speak with Arena-Champion Korra before Volus fixes the noon bout!

npcs.name: Arena-Champion Korra
npcs.greet: You've got the look of a fighter who doesn't take dive-gold! Promoter Volus locked my shield-mates in the arena vaults when we refused his poisoned salve.
talk: Volus is a secret fang of the Scaled Court! He's hiding the stolen Elinhir Star-Lens under the sands of Dragonstar Arena.
Defeat Volus in Dragonstar Arena, then track Exarch Vipir to Skyreach Pinnacle and Sanctum Ophidia!

npcs.name: Star-Warden Cassian
npcs.greet: Hold your ground against the cliff-wind! Exarch Vipir aligned the upper mirror at Skyreach Pinnacle and descended into Sanctum Ophidia.
talk: If Vipir focuses the starlight into the serpent-basin of Sanctum Ophidia, the Scaled Court will flood every pass from Belkarth to Elinhir.
Descend into Sanctum Ophidia and shatter his ritual!

story_cg_exarch_vipir.name: Exarch Vipir of the Scaled Court

story_cg_belkarth_waystation: Caravan-Master Jibril: Look at this broken crate dropped by Volus's outriders—lined with shed viper-skins and Nede star-brass from Elinhir!
Astromancer Nadia of Elinhir: He is smuggling the Star-Lens north to Dragonstar Arena under cover of the gladiator wagons.
Caravan-Master Jibril: Ride to Dragonstar and find Champion Korra before the gates close!
story_cg_arena_pit: Promoter Volus: Every drop of blood spilled on Dragonstar's sand feeds the Serpent's constellation! And the crowd pays silver to watch!
Arena-Champion Korra: Today the pit drinks a promoter's blood, Volus! Draw!
story_cg_ophidia_basin: Exarch Vipir: Look upward, mortals! The Serpent coils across the Nede zenith, and the old stars wake in Sanctum Ophidia!
Star-Warden Cassian: Smash the lens-cradle and cut down the Exarch!

quests.title: The Stolen Lens of Elinhir
quests.summary: Trace the stolen Nede Star-Lens from Elinhir to Caravan-Master Jibril in Belkarth.
intro: Thieves broke into the wizard-towers of Elinhir and stole the Nede Serpent-Lens from the great astrolabe.
Speak with Astromancer Nadia in Elinhir and follow the gladiator wagons to Caravan-Master Jibril in Belkarth.
complete: In Belkarth, Jibril showed you viper-skin packing crates linking the theft to Promoter Volus of Dragonstar Arena.

journal.start: Astromancer Nadia in Elinhir asked me to track the stolen Star-Lens to Caravan-Master Jibril in Belkarth.
journal.done: Caravan-Master Jibril linked the stolen Star-Lens to Promoter Volus at Dragonstar Arena.

quests.title: Venom on the Arena Sand
quests.summary: Rally Arena-Champion Korra in Dragonstar and defeat Promoter Volus inside Dragonstar Arena.
intro: Promoter Volus is rigging gladiator bouts in Dragonstar Arena with Scaled Court venom to harvest sacrifices.
Meet Arena-Champion Korra in Dragonstar, then enter Dragonstar Arena and defeat Promoter Volus.
complete: Promoter Volus fell on the arena sand, and his star-charts revealed that Exarch Vipir carried the lens to Skyreach Pinnacle and Sanctum Ophidia.

journal.start: I must meet Arena-Champion Korra in Dragonstar and defeat Promoter Volus in Dragonstar Arena.
journal.done: I defeated Promoter Volus in Dragonstar Arena and learned Exarch Vipir is at Skyreach Pinnacle and Sanctum Ophidia.

quests.title: The Mirror of Skyreach Pinnacle
quests.summary: Pass the anomaly at the Spellscar and meet Star-Warden Cassian at Skyreach Pinnacle.
intro: Exarch Vipir aligned the ancient Nede relay mirrors between the Spellscar and Skyreach Pinnacle.
Inspect the mirror-stone by the Spellscar and ascend to Skyreach Pinnacle to speak with Star-Warden Cassian.
complete: Star-Warden Cassian turned the upper mirror at Skyreach Pinnacle and directed you to the Scaled Court's seat in Sanctum Ophidia.

journal.start: I must check the relay stone at the Spellscar and meet Star-Warden Cassian at Skyreach Pinnacle.
journal.done: Star-Warden Cassian pinpointed Exarch Vipir's ritual inside Sanctum Ophidia.

quests.title: Coils of Sanctum Ophidia
quests.summary: Enter Sanctum Ophidia, defeat Exarch Vipir of the Scaled Court, and return the Nede Star-Lens to Astromancer Nadia in Elinhir.
intro: Deep within Sanctum Ophidia, Exarch Vipir is focusing the stolen Star-Lens over the serpent-basin.
Storm Sanctum Ophidia, slay Exarch Vipir, and return the Star-Lens to Astromancer Nadia in Elinhir.
complete: Exarch Vipir has fallen, the Scaled Court's alignment is broken, and the Nede Star-Lens gleams once more in the high tower of Elinhir.

journal.start: I must enter Sanctum Ophidia, defeat Exarch Vipir, and return the Star-Lens to Astromancer Nadia in Elinhir.
journal.done: I slew Exarch Vipir in Sanctum Ophidia and restored the Star-Lens to Elinhir.
